rationale: X has a distinctive radar-cell map, hourly bars and curl response in the hero, a dark/cream rhythm with orange accents, and six varied feature illustrations. The headline is tightly tracked and heavy but strong. Y is competent, with a mono-type dev look and a good chart, but its all-dark page with teal accents and alternating feature rows reads as a more standard dev-tool template, with flatter colour and thinner visual variety.
